tldr: When the unvaccinated share shrinks, recovering the unvaccinated risk from vaccinated and unlabeled outcome samples is an inverse-mixture problem with separate outcome-subtraction and status-audit bottlenecks. The clipped estimator and an exactly honest observable connected interval attain the matched global rate \(\rho_n=\min\{1,n^{2\kappa-1}+n^\kappa/m\}\). For fixed \(\kappa\), consistency holds exactly when \(\kappa<1/2\) and \(m/n^\kappa\to\infty\); conditional on consistency, audits dominate below the planning elbow \(m\asymp n^{1-\kappa}\), outcomes dominate above it, and the two components balance at it. At \(\kappa=1/2\) and \(m/\sqrt n\to\lambda\), compact-box transfer and location averaging prove the all-procedure lower bound \(V_\lambda^\star\), while observable coverage spending over every public \(\beta\in[\alpha,1]\), together with the independent data-free rule, gives the sharper upper cap \(U_\lambda^{\mathrm{cvx}}\). Thus \(V_\lambda^\star\le\liminf_nL_n\le\limsup_nL_n\le U_\lambda^{\mathrm{cvx}}\); equality, certified full-class computation, and sharp observable attainment remain open.
gap: Regular PUATE efficiency theory does not cover a shrinking unvaccinated share, finite expected audit controls, or uniformly honest connected-interval values. Weak-ratio and bounded-parameter methods do not determine the mixed Gaussian--Poisson all-procedure value.
fill: The project pairs a matched global rate frontier with the complete critical experiment, an expanding-location nuisance reduction, a certified continuum connected-interval game, and two-way finite-sample value transfer.
